name: MemoryLake
description: Multimodal memory platform for agents: store and search memories and documents across projects through a REST API or a hosted OAuth MCP server.

skills.name: Search Memories
skills.description: Run hybrid keyword and semantic search across a project's memories and uploaded documents.

skills.name: Add and Forget Memories
skills.description: Add, search, trace and forget memories and resolve conflicts programmatically over the REST API.

skills.name: Analyze Project Files
skills.description: Run sandboxed Python with pandas and numpy over project files, with state kept across calls.

skills.name: Query Connected Databases
skills.description: Ask natural-language questions that run as SQL against databases connected to the project.
